pages.text: $(bold)Verdict$(): $(li)Non-player entities: whatever the type (undead/arthropod/animal/other), all are found $(bold)guilty after 5 seconds$() - attack power zeroed for 60s$(li)Players: a 6 second trial with on-screen titles (name / guilt score / verdict)

$(bold)Guilt threshold (players)$(): villagers killed + animals killed + players defeated above $(bold)100$() means guilty. $(br2)$(bold)Execution$(): once a guilty verdict lands, the caster receives the Executioner Sword (1 durability, 120s, only one at a time): hitting the $(bold)defendant of this trial$() executes them instantly; hitting a $(bold)non-player$() creature that has killed you before also executes it (players can never be killed this way); any other target only takes 200% damage.
